strength.what: The footage shows you on the ball {{count}} times with your identity confirmed.
strength.why: Being available for the ball is how you influence the game.
strength.do: Keep offering angles, especially right after you pass.

improve.what: You were clearly on camera for {{minutes}} min but on the ball only {{count}} times.
improve.why: Players who show for the ball more often shape more of the game.
improve.do: Move into the gaps between opponents before the ball comes to your side.

strength.what: {{count}} of your passes reached a team-mate, verified on video.
strength.why: Keeping the ball lets your team control the game.
strength.do: Keep your head up before receiving so you can choose the best pass early.

improve.what: {{count}} of your passes did not reach a team-mate ({{completed}} verified as completed).
improve.why: Losing the ball in your own build-up gives the opponent chances.
improve.do: Check your options before the ball arrives, so you already know where the next pass goes.

strength.what: You carried the ball forward {{count}} times.
strength.why: Carrying into space moves the whole team up the pitch.
strength.do: Look for the next pass at the end of each carry.

limitation.what: I could confirm you on video for only {{confirmedMin}} min of {{analysedMin}} min analysed. {{review}} moments still need your check.
limitation.why: With so little confirmed footage I cannot judge your performance reliably.
limitation.do: Answer "Is this you?" on your moments. Each answer improves this report.

limitation.what: I cannot verify your on-ball actions: the ball was rarely trackable near you in this recording.
limitation.why: Touches, passes and duels can only be measured when the ball is in view.
limitation.do: A higher, steadier camera position that follows the ball helps most.

limitation.what: I cannot verify distance or speed: this recording has no pitch calibration.
limitation.why: Without knowing the pitch size on screen, any distance or speed figure would be a guess.
limitation.do: Physical stats are only shown when the pitch can be calibrated.

observation.what: On the {{measuredMin}} min where you are confirmed on video, no opponent was within 3 body heights of you {{freePct}}% of the time and one was within 1 body height {{tightPct}}% of the time (median distance {{median}} body heights).
observation.why: Interpretation (not verified): open space can make you available for a pass, while tight marking limits your options. The video cannot show whether a team-mate could actually play you in.
observation.do: Watch the clips and check: was there a passing line to you when you were free, and did you move off your marker when you were tight?

limitation.what: I cannot describe your positioning yet: it needs at least {{minSec}} s of confirmed footage of you, and this recording has {{confirmedSec}} s.
limitation.why: Distances to opponents are only meaningful when I know it is really you.
limitation.do: Answer "Is this you?" on your moments. Each confirmed moment adds footage I can measure.

scan_before_receive.name: Scan before you receive
scan_before_receive.how: A partner passes to you on a signal; before every touch, look over both shoulders and call out where a free team-mate is.

rondo_4v2.name: Rondo 4 v 2
rondo_4v2.how: Four players keep the ball in a 10 x 10 m square against two. Two touches maximum; swap defenders after an interception.

wall_pass_weight.name: Wall-pass weight
wall_pass_weight.how: Pass against a wall or rebounder from 8, 12 and 16 m. Aim for a pass your partner could take in stride, 20 repetitions per foot.

carry_into_space.name: Carry into space
carry_into_space.how: Receive, take a first touch into the open side and carry 10 m before passing to a cone gate. Alternate sides.

show_for_ball.name: Show for the ball
show_for_ball.how: In a 3 v 1 channel, move off the defender's shadow every time the ball moves so the passer always has a line to you.

width_and_depth.name: Width and depth
width_and_depth.how: Play 4 v 4 with wide gates: a goal only counts after the ball reaches a winger who stayed wide.

build_up_angles.name: Build-up angles
build_up_angles.how: Play out from the goal line against one presser. Offer a diagonal angle to the ball carrier on every pass.

first_touch_away.name: First touch away from pressure
first_touch_away.how: A coach shouts "left" or "right" as the pass arrives; take the first touch away from that side.

distribution_targets.name: Distribution targets
distribution_targets.how: From the goal area, play to three marked target zones with feet and hands, 10 repetitions each.
